As for maintaining those connections, well, I try to be there for people when they need someone to talk to. I send messages or give them a call just to check in, you know? And I make an effort to remember important dates and events for them, like birthdays or anniversaries. It's not always easy, but it's important to me to show that I care.

I also try to be open and listen to what others have to say. It's like, when you're open, people feel more comfortable sharing their thoughts and feelings with you. And that's really special, I think. It's like, we all have our own stories, and it's nice to be a part of each other's lives.
